text.title: CLAUDE.md Creation — Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact is the committed CLAUDE.md plus this JSON record of how it satisfies 01-core-rules.xml: every command extracted from a manifest and run once, the secret scan clean with env vars by name, the template's token budget held, a load-bearing structure list with purposes, per-app delegation in a monorepo, repo-specific gotchas, personal settings kept local, and the manifest-resync check in CI. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: owner/name of the repository the CLAUDE.md is committed to
single or monorepo; monorepo requires the per-app delegation block (r-monorepo-root-delegates-via-imports)
minimal (250 tokens), standard (500) or monorepo (700) — fixes the token budget (r-token-budget-declared-and-held)
tokens of the committed file; capped by the template's budget (r-token-budget-declared-and-held)
each with its manifest source, a trailing comment and ran_ok true on a clean checkout (r-commands-extracted-and-executed)
scanner, clean true, env vars referenced by name with a pointer to .env.example (r-zero-secrets-env-by-name-only)
at most 20 load-bearing paths, each with a purpose; generated dirs excluded (r-structure-lists-load-bearing-paths-only)
each path with purpose and exists true at commit time; empty when the section is absent (r-structure-lists-load-bearing-paths-only)
each entry naming a file, env var, command, version pin or lint rule (r-gotchas-are-repo-specific)
grep for /Users/, /home/, C:\ and personal handles clean; CLAUDE.local.md gitignored (r-personal-and-machine-specifics-stay-local)
CI job or pre-commit hook that fails on manifest drift; its location is in evidence[] (r-commands-resync-on-manifest-change)
when layout is monorepo: per-app CLAUDE.md files that exist and are imported, root_restates_app_commands false (r-monorepo-root-delegates-via-imports)
URLs: the CI run that executed the commands, the secret scan, the resync check definition

forbidden.pattern: a command with ran_ok false or no manifest source — believed to exist, never run (fm-stale-commands)
secrets_scan.clean false, or an env var with a literal value instead of NAME=<required> (fm-secret-pasted-in)
token_count above the template's budget: 250 minimal, 500 standard, 700 monorepo (fm-three-thousand-token-novel)
structure with more than 20 entries, an entry without a purpose, or node_modules / dist / .venv / __pycache__ listed (fm-tree-dump-structure)
a gotcha that names nothing concrete — "write clean code", "add tests" (fm-generic-advice-as-gotchas)
layout monorepo with root_restates_app_commands true or a per-app file that does not exist
resync_check missing, or one that does not fail when a manifest changes without a CLAUDE.md edit

allowed-transformations.transformation: Where a manifest has more than 20 scripts, list the ones a developer runs in the first hour and point at the manifest for the rest.
Where a key file moves, update its path in the same PR rather than dropping the row.
Record a token_count measured with the same tokenizer each time; the budget is a ceiling, not a target.

output-contract.example: { "repo": "acme/intake-api", "layout": "single", "template": "standard", "token_count": 480, "commands": [ {"command": "make dev", "source": "Makefile", "comment": "Start development server (port 8000)", "ran_ok": true}, {"command": "pytest --cov=src -x", "source": "pyproject.toml", "comment": "Run tests, stop at first failure", "ran_ok": true}, {"command": "ruff check . --fix", "source": "pyproject.toml", "comment": "Lint + auto-fix (rules: E/F/I/B/T20/DJ)", "ran_ok": true}, {"command": "mypy src", "source": "pyproject.toml", "comment": "Type check", "ran_ok": true}, {"command": "alembic upgrade head", "source": "Makefile", "comment": "Apply migrations", "ran_ok": true} ], "secrets_scan": {"tool": "gitleaks", "clean": true, "env_vars_by_name_only": true, "env_example_referenced": true}, "structure": [ {"path": "src/api/", "purpose": "FastAPI routes, v1/ per API version"}, {"path": "src/core/", "purpose": "Business logic, config, security helpers"}, {"path": "src/models/", "purpose": "SQLAlchemy models"}, {"path": "src/schemas/", "purpose": "Pydantic schemas"}, {"path": "tests/", "purpose": "unit/ mirrors src/, integration/ hits endpoints"} ], "key_files": [ {"path": "src/core/config.py", "purpose": "Settings read from env; nothing else reads env directly", "exists": true}, {"path": "src/api/deps.py", "purpose": "FastAPI dependencies (auth, db session)", "exists": true}, {"path": ".env.example", "purpose": "Required env vars; copy to .env before running", "exists": true} ], "gotchas": [ {"entry": "DATABASE_URL has no default; the app exits at startup without it", "names": "env-var"}, {"entry": "No print() in production code; ruff T20 blocks the commit", "names": "lint-rule"}, {"entry": "Run alembic upgrade head before first start or the health check returns 503", "names": "command"} ], "local_settings": {"personal_paths_grep_clean": true, "claude_local_md_gitignored": true}, "resync_check": {"kind": "ci-job", "location": ".github/workflows/claude-md-sync.yml", "fails_on_manifest_drift": true}, "evidence": [ "https://ci.example.com/acme/intake-api/runs/8812", "https://ci.example.com/acme/intake-api/runs/8812/gitleaks", "https://github.com/acme/intake-api/blob/main/.github/workflows/claude-md-sync.yml" ] }

list.item: Every command names its manifest source, carries a comment, and ran with exit 0 on a clean checkout.
The secret scan is clean; every env var is NAME=<required> and the file points at .env.example.
token_count is within the template's budget: 250 minimal, 500 standard, 700 monorepo.
structure has at most 20 entries, each with a purpose, none generated; every key file exists at commit time.
Every gotcha names a file, env var, command, version pin or lint rule.
The committed file greps clean for /Users/, /home/, C:\ and personal handles; CLAUDE.local.md is gitignored.
In a monorepo the root delegates to per-app CLAUDE.md files that exist and restates none of their commands.
The resync check exists, fails on manifest drift, and its location is in evidence[].
